APP.NAME: Gravity Guy
APP.TITLE: Play | Gravity Guy
APP.START_COPY: Run the orbital causeway. Flip between floor and ceiling to clear barriers and broken rails. Keep going as the pace rises.
APP.PAUSED_COPY: Your run is frozen. Resume when you’re ready. Switching tabs pauses automatically.
APP.OVER_COPY: A barrier or the void caught you. Find your rhythm and give it another run.
APP.GUIDE_FLIP: Tap once to reverse gravity. You can flip again in midair.
APP.GUIDE_AVOID: Striped blocks stop your run. Dashed rail gaps open into the void.
APP.GUIDE_SCORE: Distance is your score. Your best stays in this browser when storage is available.
APP.PLAYFIELD: Gravity runner playfield. Use Space or Arrow Up to flip gravity.
APP.FOOTER: An original arcade experiment inspired by gravity runners.
